🇵🇭🇮🇩 ANCIENT SEAFARERS MASTERED OCEAN TRAVEL 40,000 YEARS AGO 

A groundbreaking study proves ancient people in Southeast Asia were skilled sailors 40,000 years ago, far earlier than believed possible.

Stone tools discovered in the Philippines, Indonesia, and Timor-Leste reveal evidence of plant processing used to extract fibers for ropes, nets, and bindings essential for boatbuilding and deep-sea fishing. 

Combined with fishing hooks and remnants of tuna and sharks, these sites show a sophisticated maritime society.

The findings challenge the belief that technological advancement was centered only in Africa and Europe. 

These prehistoric explorers weren't drifting on bamboo rafts by accident. 

They were highly skilled navigators with the knowledge and technology to cross deep oceans.

Their boat-building expertise likely made the region a hub for maritime innovation that still flourishes today.

Source: Express US

Ever feel like chess just got a turbo boost? Like, magical spells on the board, onchain vibes, and a token that's got everyone talking.
 That's @AnichessGame aniche in a nutshell, and man, the last few weeks have been wild. Let's unpack it quick.

First off, those puzzles? Absolute fire. Over 3 million solved since summer, 150k players diving in for real stakes. It's not just brain teasers, it's decisions that hit your wallet. We crushed Onchain Summer, snagged second in mini-apps, and now Season 2's lurking. If you haven't grinded one, fix that today.

$CHECK dropped like a knight fork last week. Liquidity kicked off on Aerodrome, claims went live, and staking pools are popping. OG crew's got that Queen of Time setup lock in for three months, snag M8 rewards plus a fat bonus slice. Public fountain's open too, flexible vibes with launch bonuses. Staked mine day one; feels like holding the center.

Shout to the Pudgy takeover cutest chaos ever. Penguins crashing the board, single-elim brackets that wrecked nerves. CheckPengu, Telbatz, and Portgas clawed to the top, best-of-five turned six-game epic. $10k pool, Lil Pudgy NFT on the line. GGs all around; if you missed the stream, catch the highlights.

We're hitting campuses hard too Philippines uni tour with Bitskwela was electric. Kids geeking over spells and strategy, Faker-level hype spilling out. Education meets onchain chess? Yeah, that's the future we're building. Q4's stacked with more drops, bridges to Abstract, and that 2026 roadmap's got me plotting moves already.

This ain't just a game it's a crew. 75% USDC back to early puzzle grinders who dropped on passes. We check in, lift each other. If you're lurking, jump in. Solve a puzzle, stake some CHECK, or just vibe in Discord. Board's waiting. What's your next play?
gCheck to all those who actually $CHECK
